desktop.notes:
• Phone: Add to album lists your Cullect albums from the PC (only the name is saved with the photo - nothing is copied). The PC sees it next time it opens the folder. Copy to the phone's Gallery is still there, as its own option.
• Filters: new Albums chip - in an album, not in album X, or in no album. Works with the Keep / ★ tabs.
• Fullscreen: only the photo (no top bar, no coloured frame) and a small status icon at the bottom - pale when it is only the AI's pick. The top bar's text shows in the I info.
• Folder done: a colour bar with Discard / Keep / ★ counts and %, and how many photos are in albums. The finished steps fold away behind Review again.
• Top bar order: Discard, Keep, Favourite.
